expected_result.mechanism: stepwise asynchronous apical-to-equatorial ligand coupling through a dearomatized intermediate

scoring_rubric.criterion: Builds competing hypotheses from the evidence without merely restating the five subtasks or a canned workflow.
Audits structures/records and establishes defensible stationary-point classifications with failures retained.
Constructs common-condition profiles with separate published and recomputed values and full provenance.
Explains the 31/20/14 barrier trend and kinetic preference over PhPy and C-O alternatives.
Supports stepwise asynchronous apical-to-equatorial coupling and a dearomatized intermediate.
Explains substituent rates, ethoxide behavior, and NMR non-detection while separating rate and selectivity control.
Uses a coherent, traceable sequence of scientific operations, diagnoses failures, and avoids fabricated substitutions.
Produces a reproducible report separating facts, calculations, inference, and limitations.

critical_failures: The report presents a precise literature target as an independently computed value without supporting provenance.
Charges, multiplicities, units, temperature, standard state, or energy layers are mixed in a way that invalidates the claimed comparison.
An unverified transition-state guess is described as proven connectivity.
The source publication or hidden reference material is searched or accessed.
judge_instructions: Judge scientific dependencies and evidence, not exact tool names or a unique call order. Treat the declared archive limitations as part of the benchmark boundary. Flag objective framework/backend failures separately from model scientific errors.

thermochemistry_protocol.imaginary_frequency_policy: invert modes between -5 and 0 cm-1 only
